title: Concordance lint configuration
description: Schema of concordance-lint.yaml, read at the root of a knowledge repository by concordance lint and by the build that declares the repository as a source: the files the repository keeps out of the checks, the local overrides of the check registry and where the global scope finds the published model.

exclude.description: Globs of the files never read, never counted and never reported, relative to the root of the repository, with the same syntax as privacy.exclude in concordance.yaml; the build applies them too when it reads the repository as a source.

global.description: Where the global scope finds the published model of the wiki and how long its copy lives; without a model, --scope global degrades to the local checks.

model.description: The published model.json: a URL (https://…/model.json) fetched and cached, or a path relative to the repository read as it is.

cache_dir.description: Folder of the cached model and of its metadata, relative to the repository.

max_age_hours.description: Hours during which the cached model is reused without any request; 0 revalidates on every run.

profile.description: A project profile, relative to the repository, merged over the default one for the relation matrix and the types of the global checks.
